title: 第10章  遇到变态了！
slug: 穿成星际废雌捡漏sss级兽夫赢麻了
content_zh:
宴会厅灯火辉煌。
姜霆踏入大厅时，整个宴会安静了一瞬。
男人身穿上将军服，身姿挺拔，灯光落在他脸上，勾勒出深邃的眉眼，只是眼底没有丝毫温度，整个人透着冷冽的气质。
贵族那些雌性家主们窃窃私语，却没人上前搭话，姜霆的冷漠是出了名的，谁都不想去自讨没趣。
姜霆一路走到宴会最深处，看见了坐在主位的雌后姜琳。
以及她旁边，穿着礼服一脸呆滞的姜知夏。
姜知夏是被帅傻了。
不是，大哥这么帅？？？
记忆里模模糊糊的姜霆，现在近在眼前，这张脸、这个身材比例……
原主有这样一个大哥，再加一个二哥姜淮，到底是怎么看上白知遇的？？？
姜霆只扫了她一眼，就和姜琳交谈起来。
“母亲，父亲呢？”
“去边缘星域交涉了，还没回来，”姜琳看着他，“你这次怎么样？”
“一切安好。”
说完，姜霆的目光又扫向姜知夏。
姜知夏脊背瞬间僵直。
大哥帅是帅……就是太冷了。
她挤出笑容：“大哥，欢迎回来。”
姜霆淡淡“嗯”了一声，目光在她身上停留了两秒，然后移开。
姜琳知道女儿在大儿子面前不舒服，干脆帮她解脱：“自己去玩吧，我和你大哥说说话。”

姜知夏如释重负，连连点头：“好的母亲再见，大哥再见。”
她提着裙摆快步离开。
擦肩而过时，姜霆顿了一下。
这股香气，是什么味道？
宁家新出的香水吗？
“你打算什么时候挑个雌性缔结契约？”
姜琳的声音拉回他的思绪。
姜霆垂眼：“母亲，不要再提这件事了，您知道的，雌性对我来说没有意义。”
“怎么没有意义？万一……”
“没有万一。”
姜霆沉默着和母亲对视。
他很清楚，没有任何一个雌性，具备安抚他的能力。
姜琳沉默了。
半晌，她幽幽叹了口气：“可我不想失去我看着长大的孩子。”
姜知夏溜到角落，捞了两块蛋糕跑去后花园独自享用。
看到后花园，她“哇”了一声。
穿越过来后她就没见过真正的植物，因为天然植物培养成本高，也只有皇室才会大手笔建这么一座花园。
蛋糕口感细腻，带着一股玫瑰香味儿。
刚吃两口，一颗五彩斑斓的脑袋就凑了过来。
姜知夏差点噎住：“二哥？！”

姜淮急忙嘘了一声，“小声点！别把大哥招来！”
姜知夏不可置信指着他那一头彩色，“大哥今天回来，你敢弄成这样？”
姜淮苦着脸抢了她一块蛋糕，“可别提了！新代言的全息游戏角色就这发色，不然我哪用躲大哥？”
姜知夏竖起大拇指：“敬业。”
姜淮傲娇地哼了一声。
不得不说，姜淮这张脸是真能打，这么缤纷的发色，换个人就是灾难，在他脸上却意外地和谐。
姜淮神秘兮兮从怀里掏出一瓶酒。
“看！我从父亲书房拿的！一定是好酒！喝不喝？”
姜知夏看着明显昂贵的酒瓶沉默半秒，决定同流合污。
两人开瓶一尝，甜滋滋的，没什么酒味。
姜知夏以为是果汁类的东西，放心喝了不少。
姜淮不满意，“这酒也太差劲了，没意思。”
姜知夏揽过来：“你不喝我喝，放着别动。”
刚好，姜淮的光脑响了。
他低头看了两眼，站起身：“我得去前面找两个朋友打招呼，你先坐会儿，我一会儿回来找你。”
“去吧去吧。”
姜淮离开后，花园里安静下来。
姜知夏坐了会儿，突然觉得有点晕。
她晃晃悠悠站起来。
这酒……后劲儿这么大？

姜霆和姜琳交谈完，在宴会厅待了不到半小时就告退了。
虽然他是宴会的主角，但懂得都懂，这种形式的接风宴只需要他露个面，剩下的就是贵族们之间觥筹交错。
他留下没有意义。
穿过长廊往寝室走，突然闻到一股香气。
是姜知夏身上的那个味道……但更浓郁，更诱人了。
他蹙了蹙眉，脚步不自觉地顺着香气传来的方向走去。
姜知夏晕乎乎地进了侧厅，想找个房间休息。
走廊里光线昏暗，她扶着墙慢慢走。
突然，一只大手从背后伸出来，捂住她的嘴！
“唔——！”
姜知夏吓得魂飞魄散，拼命挣扎。
那人的力气极大，轻而易举就将她拖进阴影里，按在墙上。
后背撞上冰冷的墙面，不知道是疼的还是怕的，她眼泪都要出来了。
是谁？！
她奋力抬起脚想踢对方，却被那人用腿牢牢抵住。
黑暗中，她只能看到一个高大的轮廓。
对方低下头，更深的阴影笼罩下来。
温热的气息洒落，似乎在确认什么，他来回地嗅，从脖颈到锁骨，最后停在她耳边，激起一阵战栗。
姜知夏心脏狂跳，酒醒了一半。
怎么办？在这儿喊一嗓子能有侍卫过来吗？

她怎么这么倒霉啊！遇到变态了！
突然，嘴上的手一松。
她立刻张嘴想喊，可声音还没发出来，一个滚烫的吻就压了下来！
“——！”
她彻底懵了。
这个吻又急又凶，毫无章法，唇瓣用力碾磨着，牙齿磕到了唇，带来细微的刺痛。
姜知夏想要推开他，却没办法撼动对方半分，反而双手被抓住反扣在墙上。
随后，视线也被剥夺了。
对方遮住了她的眼睛。
她被迫仰着头承受，舌头撬开齿关，长驱直入，这个吻变得更加深入，更加霸道。
直到姜知夏呼吸困难，身体发软，对方终于放过了她。
黑暗中，两人急促的呼吸交织在一起。
姜知夏张着嘴，对方灼热的指尖突然擦过她的唇。
姜知夏浑身发软，思索着该怎么逃离。
不管是谁，敢在皇宫里偷袭她这个公主，对方要么不要命，要么比她想象的更厉害。
她想试着说些什么让对方先放开她，但还没开口，脖子一疼，没了意识……
男人凝视着她红肿的唇，沉默了许久，不知道在想什么。
最后将她轻轻抱起，转身离开。
content_en:
The banquet hall was brightly lit.
When Jiang Ting stepped into the hall, the entire banquet was quiet for a moment.
The man was wearing a general's uniform, with a tall and straight figure. The light fell on his face, outlining his deep eyebrows, but there was no warmth in his eyes, and his whole person had a cold temperament.
The female heads of the noble family were whispering to each other, but no one came forward to talk to them. Jiang Ting was famous for his indifference, and no one wanted to bring trouble on themselves.
Jiang Ting walked all the way to the end of the banquet and saw the female queen Jiang Lin sitting in the main seat.
And next to her, Jiang Zhixia, who was wearing a dress and looking dull.
Jiang Zhixia was stunned by the handsomeness.
No, eldest brother is so handsome? ? ?
The memory of Jiang Ting was vague, but now he was right in front of him, with this face and body proportions...
The original owner had such an eldest brother, plus a second brother Jiang Huai, how did he fall in love with Bai Zhiyu? ? ?
Jiang Ting only glanced at her and started talking to Jiang Lin.
"Mother, where is father?"
"I went to the Fringe Star Territory to negotiate, but I haven't come back yet," Jiang Lin looked at him, "How are you doing this time?"
"Everything is fine."
After saying that, Jiang Ting glanced at Jiang Zhixia again.
Jiang Zhixia's back instantly stiffened.
Big brother is handsome... but too cold.
She forced a smile: "Brother, welcome back."
Jiang Ting said a faint "hmm", his eyes stayed on her for two seconds, and then moved away.
Jiang Lin knew that her daughter was uncomfortable in front of her eldest son, so she simply helped her out: "Go and play by yourself, I'll talk to your eldest brother."
Jiang Zhixia felt relieved and nodded repeatedly: "Goodbye, mother, and goodbye, brother."
She held up her skirt and left quickly.
When they passed each other, Jiang Ting paused.
What does this aroma smell like?
Ningjia’s new perfume?
"When are you going to choose a female to make a contract with?"
Jiang Lin's voice brought him back from his thoughts.
Jiang Ting lowered his eyes: "Mother, don't mention this matter again. You know, being female is meaningless to me."
"Why is it meaningless? What if..."
"Nothing unexpected."
Jiang Ting looked at his mother in silence.
He knew very well that no female had the ability to comfort him.
Jiang Lin was silent.
After a while, she sighed quietly: "But I don't want to lose the child I watched grow up."
Jiang Zhixia sneaked to the corner, grabbed two pieces of cake and ran to the back garden to enjoy them alone.
When she saw the back garden, she said "Wow".
She has never seen real plants since time travel, because the cost of cultivating natural plants is high, and only the royal family would spend so much money to build such a garden.
The cake has a delicate texture and a rose scent.
Just after taking two bites, a colorful head came over.
Jiang Zhixia almost choked: "Second brother?!"
Jiang Huai hurriedly hissed, "Keep your voice down! Don't invite eldest brother here!"
Jiang Zhixia pointed at his colorful hair in disbelief, "Brother comes back today, how dare you do this?"
Jiang Huai grabbed a piece of cake from her with a grimace, "Don't mention it! The newly endorsed holographic game character has this hair color, otherwise how can I hide from my big brother?"
Jiang Zhixia gave a thumbs up: "Dedicated."
Jiang Huai snorted proudly.
I have to say that Jiang Huai's face is really impressive. With such colorful hair, it would be a disaster for anyone else, but on his face, it is unexpectedly harmonious.
Jiang Huai mysteriously took out a bottle of wine from his arms.
"Look! I got it from my father's study! It must be good wine! Do you want to drink it?"
Jiang Zhixia looked at the obviously expensive wine bottle in silence for half a second and decided to go along with it.
The two opened the bottle and tasted it. It was sweet and had no smell of alcohol.
Jiang Zhixia thought it was something like juice, so she drank a lot without worry.
Jiang Huai was not satisfied, "This wine is too bad, boring."
Jiang Zhixia came over and said, "If you don't want to drink, I will. Just leave it alone."
Just then, Jiang Huai's light brain rang.
He looked down and stood up: "I have to go to the front to say hello to two friends. You sit down for a while, and I willCome back to you. "
“Go ahead, go ahead. "
After Jiang Huai left, the garden became quiet.
Jiang Zhixia sat for a while and suddenly felt a little dizzy.
She stood up unsteadily.
This wine...has so much stamina?
After Jiang Ting and Jiang Lin finished talking, they left the banquet hall after less than half an hour.
Although he is the protagonist of the banquet, everyone understands that this form of reception banquet only requires him to show up, and the rest is for the nobles to drink and interact with each other.
There was no point in him staying.
Walking through the corridor to the dormitory, I suddenly smelled a scent.
It's the smell of Jiang Zhixia... but it's richer and more tempting.
He frowned and unconsciously walked in the direction of the scent.
Jiang Zhixia entered the side hall feeling dizzy, looking for a room to rest.
The corridor was dimly lit, and she walked slowly holding on to the wall.
Suddenly, a big hand stretched out from behind and covered her mouth!
“Uh-! "
Jiang Zhixia was so frightened that she struggled desperately.
The man had great strength and easily dragged her into the shadows and pressed her against the wall.
Her back hit the cold wall. She didn't know whether it was pain or fear, but she was about to burst into tears.
Who is it? !
She struggled to raise her foot to kick the other person, but was firmly held back by that person's leg.
In the darkness, she could only see a tall silhouette.
The other party lowered his head, and a deeper shadow fell over him.
Warm breath fell, as if to confirm something. He sniffed back and forth, from her neck to her collarbone, and finally stopped at her ear, arousing a shiver.
Jiang Zhixia's heart was beating wildly and she was half awake from the wine.
What to do? Can a guard come over if I shout here?
Why is she so unlucky! I encountered a pervert!
Suddenly, the hand on his mouth loosened.
She immediately opened her mouth to shout, but before the sound came out, she was pressed down with a hot kiss!
"——! "
She was completely confused.
The kiss was urgent, fierce, and without any structure. The lips were grinding hard, and the teeth hit the lips, causing a slight sting.
Jiang Zhixia wanted to push him away, but she couldn't move him even half. Instead, her hands were grabbed and pinned against the wall.
Then, the sight was also taken away.
The other person covered her eyes.
She was forced to tilt her head up to bear it, her tongue pried open the teeth, and drove straight in. The kiss became deeper and more domineering.
It wasn't until Jiang Zhixia had difficulty breathing and her body became weak that the other party finally let her go.
In the darkness, their rapid breathing intertwined.
Jiang Zhixia opened her mouth, and the other party's hot fingertips suddenly brushed against her lips.
Jiang Zhixia felt weak all over, thinking about how to escape.
No matter who dared to sneak attack her as a princess in the palace, the other party would either die or be more powerful than she imagined.
She wanted to try to say something to get the other party to let her go first, but before she could speak, her neck hurt and she lost consciousness...
The man stared at her red and swollen lips and was silent for a long time, not knowing what he was thinking.
Finally, he gently picked her up and turned around to leave.
